title: Ukrainian Honey Cake Kulich
description: A traditional Ukrainian honey cake featuring sesame seeds and a char-grilled flavor, perfect for a breakfast or dessert.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Grease two 9-inch (23cm) round cake pans and line the bottoms with parchment paper.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt. Set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, use an electric mixer to beat the eggs and sugars until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes.
Add the honey and vanilla extract to the egg mixture and beat until well combined.
With the mixer on low speed, gradually add the flour mixture to the egg mixture and mix until just combined.
Divide the batter evenly between the prepared pans and smooth the tops.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove the cakes from the oven and let them cool in the pans for 5 minutes.
Transfer the cakes to a wire rack to cool completely.
To make the glaze, whisk together the honey and powdered sugar until smooth.
Drizzle the glaze over the cooled cakes and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Char-grill the cakes over medium heat for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until nicely browned.
